records.title: LFP · SINTEF d07eb6 · cycle 3 · delithiation

x.definition: (Q - Q_first)/(Q_last - Q_first), from first to last retained point of this branch. Increases with passed capacity in BOTH directions. Not absolute stoichiometry or whole-cell SOC.
x.domain_basis: Measured branch endpoints, independently normalized for each specimen and direction.

cell_link.evidence: No commercial cell identity established for this record.

provenance.location: cycle=3; step=2; source_row is zero-based row position in Parquet

processing.direction_rule: Li-metal half-cell: positive current and increasing working-electrode potential = delithiation; negative current and decreasing potential = lithiation; verified for this branch.
processing.potential_changes: none; native source floating-point values preserved
processing.rest_steps: excluded; these are finite-current pseudo-OCP points, not GITT equilibrium points

limitations: C/50 pseudo-OCP retains finite-current polarization; not a claimed equilibrium OCP.
Absolute stoichiometric endpoints are unknown and require external balancing evidence.
Each branch is normalized separately; branch endpoints are not assumed to represent identical lithium fractions.
Two specimens and their branches are replicates from ONE dataset, not independent literature sources.
No commercial full-cell identity or full-cell model validation is established.
